name: SmartOptics Group ASA
blurb: SmartOptics is a Norwegian supplier of open optical networking hardware and software — transceivers, optical line systems, and management platforms — used by enterprises, governments, and telecoms carriers to build metro, regional, and data-centre interconnect networks. The company competes in the 'open optical' market where carriers avoid vendor lock-in by disaggregating optical hardware from the control plane. Founded 1990, headquartered in Oslo.
recent: As of early May 2026, SMOP.OL was trading at approximately $6.03 (NOK equivalent), with a market capitalisation near $591M and trailing twelve-month revenue of $75.3M. The stock has been caught in the broader photonics sector re-rating driven by AI data-centre optical demand, though SmartOptics is more of an adjacent beneficiary — its open-networking solutions address metro and DCI (data-centre interconnect) use cases rather than the hyperscale co-packaged optics buildout at the centre of the AI optical thesis.
